procedure.en: There is no zero to find: the macro ring is printed A–E with 1–9 inside each letter, and the finest macro position is the first. Baratza sells a shim kit to recalibrate the range.
procedure.pt-BR: Não há zero a ser encontrado: o anel macro é impresso de A a E com 1 a 9 dentro de cada letra, e a posição macro mais fina é a primeira. A Baratza vende um kit de calços para recalibrar a faixa.

notes: Values are Honest Coffee Guide's macro numbering 1–31 across the 30 macro steps (Baratza prints A–E × 1–9). A separate stepless micro ring 1–9 sits inside each macro step, which is how Baratza gets '270 settings'; the micro ring is not modelled here, so use it for fine-tuning around the macro value. Honest Coffee Guide's computed slope is about 24 µm per macro step ((950 − 230) ÷ 30), a particle-size estimate, not burr travel. Baratza product page: baratza.com/en-us/product/settetm-270-zcg1270.
